issues.title: speech() action / android.speech source: expose dictation to .owl widgets
issues.disposition: Pending: a speech widget API is a new language/runtime capability; no implementation in this change.

issues.title: Option for see-through Linux windows and terminal tiles (show the wallpaper)
issues.disposition: Pending: translucent Linux windows require compositor/rendering work. The native preview has no Wayland tiles.

issues.title: Codex CLI sandbox fails under OmaLauncher PRoot ("cannot establish app-server socket mount isolation")
issues.disposition: Mitigated/documented: the legacy bwrap shim now refuses execution with exit 78 instead of silently discarding isolation. Genuine namespace sandbox support remains unavailable; see SECURITY.md. No bwrap/PRoot in the preview.

issues.title: Prompt bar voice input stops after a few words — need continuous dictation
issues.disposition: Pending: continuous recognition/restart behavior needs a speech lifecycle implementation and microphone/device tests.

issues.title: Third-party voice typing apps (Wispr Flow, etc.) don't work inside Linux app windows like OpenCode
issues.disposition: Partial: adapted draft PR #38 normal-editor IME metadata, extracted text, composing replacement and focus handling. Third-party voice keyboards still require physical tests; no universal compatibility claim.

issues.title: Stop switch for Linux service
issues.disposition: Implemented in original app: stop/resume retains the rootfs, gates new guest processes, pauses Linux widgets/audio/service, waits for managed package work, and persists stop across launcher restart. Host gate tests pass; process termination/resume needs a phone test. Preview uses Termux lifecycle separately.

issues.title: [Security]: shared/store widgets can run arbitrary guest shell; review heuristics are bypassable
issues.disposition: Partial: explicit shared/store widget trust notices and SECURITY.md. Regex/agent reviews are not isolation. Per-capability gates and reapproval after file changes are still missing. Preview does not load OWL/store widgets.

issues.title: Terminal tile only wakes when you tap the prompt
issues.disposition: Pending: first-press vertical scrolling versus horizontal paging needs gesture arbitration. PR #40 handles simultaneous contacts, not this separate tile activation bug. No physical reproduction available.

issues.title: automatically apply the current theme’s static background as the system (and lock) wallpaper
issues.disposition: Implemented: #77 adapted to style.toml, opt-in automatic sync, explicit apply and truthful outcomes. Preview offers image or palette-color application. Preserves detected live home/lock wallpapers; bounded worker decode. Android/OEM wallpaper tests remain.

issues.title: Import home screen layout from another launcher (Samsung One UI Home)
issues.disposition: Pending: import format/mapping and migration preview for other launchers are not implemented.

issues.title: Feature idea: voice typing and swipe keyboard in terminal tiles (agent sessions)
issues.disposition: Partial: same keyboard changes as #78. Swipe/dictation reliability still depends on IME and must be checked physically.

issues.title: Feature idea: trending widgets, likes and reviews in the store
issues.disposition: Pending: popularity/likes/reviews require a hosted service, identity/abuse rules and a client protocol; not present in this repository.

issues.title: Feature proposal: encrypted layered backup/restore (SAF/WebDAV + incremental daily/hourly)
issues.disposition: Pending: encrypted, scheduled, layered/WebDAV backups need design, migration and restore verification. No backup encryption claims.

issues.title: Improvement idea: make the widgets dynamically move around
issues.disposition: Integrated #55: live displacement while dragging, bounded search, preserved sizes, algorithm regression tests. Physical drag behavior remains unverified.

issues.title: Expose ongoing navigation notifications (Google Maps turn-by-turn) to widgets
issues.disposition: Implemented: original notification source retains navigation/other ongoing notifications, excluding own service and group summaries. Preview has live refresh, current-key revalidation, private-profile filtering and Android 14 pending-intent options. Device notification tests remain.

issues.title: Local subnet access dropped on Android 17
issues.disposition: Implemented for original target 37: permission declaration, install request, existing-install request and settings recovery. Gate starts at API 37 per Android docs. Preview targets 36; Termux owns its own network permissions.

issues.title: Feature idea: android.apps source (installed apps) and opt-in shared storage in Linux
issues.disposition: Pending in original OWL: android.apps source and shared-storage API are not added. Preview app catalog uses LauncherApps; files use Android document selection. PR #4 needs privacy-aware adaptation.

issues.title: PWAs installed from Chrome/Brave never appear (no WebAPK, no shortcut)
issues.disposition: Implemented in preview: system pin-shortcut confirmation, pinned shortcut listing and launching, private-profile rejection. Original app PR #63 remains pending; its catalog changes overlap #72 and need a separate privacy-aware port.

issues.title: Feature proposal: permission-controlled external desktop bridge
issues.disposition: Pending: draft #45 proposes an external display bridge. No host consent/session infrastructure has been merged.

issues.title: Add Hermes Agent to the agent list, and allow a custom command per agent
issues.disposition: Pending original agent registry/custom-agent integration (#85). Native preview already supports user-entered Termux commands; that is not validation of Hermes installation on Android.

issues.title: Feature idea: android.location source for widgets (GPS)
issues.disposition: Pending: GPS/location source (#42) not imported. Original weather retains upstream manual city selection and now adapts #59 recovery/retry without dropping city support.

issues.title: App Tray
issues.disposition: Already present in current upstream: the drawer search-position/top ordering setting. #32 adapted keyboard/pinning/filter/drag-edge behaviors retain it.

issues.title: Feature idea: an Omarchy-style control and notification panel on swipe down?
issues.disposition: Partial in preview: existing controls, inbox and floating panel share Omarchy colors; inbox corrected here. Android secure shade/lock/recents replacement and a unified system panel remain outside what this APK implements.

issues.title: Feature idea: reply to a notification from a widget
issues.disposition: Pending: RemoteInput reply and OWL language validation are not implemented. Opening a notification is not an inline reply.

issues.title: App names don't update after changing the phone's language
issues.disposition: Implemented: original catalog reloads labels/icons on locale change, date formatter cache keys include locale, notification label keys include locale. Preview refreshes labels on locale broadcasts. Locale-switch host regression added; Android broadcast behavior needs device testing.

issues.title: Accent-insensitive app search?
issues.disposition: Integrated #66 in original; preview uses equivalent Unicode normalization for label and package search. Accent and non-Latin host cases pass.

issues.title: Guest DNS ignores Android's active network (breaks Tailscale/MagicDNS and any VPN)
issues.disposition: Pending in legacy PRoot: hardcoded guest DNS remains; active-network/VPN/Private-DNS integration needs a resolver bridge and network tests. Preview has no guest resolv.conf override and uses native Termux/Android networking; VPN behavior is still unqualified.

issues.title: Small security basics: SECURITY.md, Dependabot, and CI hardening?
issues.disposition: Partial: SECURITY.md, immutable GitHub Action pins, read-default/job-scoped release permissions, Dependabot and native-preview CI. Hosting-side alerts/protection/private reporting are not configured from this local fork. Legacy download trust still needs work.

issues.title: Feature idea: GPU acceleration on Adreno (Snapdragon) phones via Mesa Turnip
issues.disposition: Pending: #67 Turnip driver support needs Adreno hardware, verified driver integration and rollback testing. No kernel/driver changes were made on the Tecno.

issues.title: Would you welcome a CONTRIBUTING.md and issue/PR templates?
issues.disposition: Implemented: CONTRIBUTING.md, bug/feature templates and PR template, with separate build/device guidance for the two applications.

issues.title: Feature idea: a small page indicator on home?
issues.disposition: Pending: configurable page indicators are not added.

issues.title: Hide the "no widgets on this page" hint outside arrange mode?
issues.disposition: Implemented in original app: empty-page hints appear while arranging/carrying or when the whole home is empty; intentionally blank pages stay clear.

issues.title: Terminal widget restarts on its own after `exit`
issues.disposition: Implemented in original app: first-appearance gate prevents automatic restart after exit when a tile re-enters composition. Explicit tap still restarts. Lifecycle host tests pass.

issues.title: More App bar Customization
issues.disposition: Pending: configurable bottom-strip pins (#18) are not imported; existing home pinning remains.
